about: a plain question to the chat agent

json.chatInput: What is the difference between a process and a thread? Answer in two sentences.

expect.offline: No outside read or write: the reply is compared. The model name (deepseek/deepseek-r1-distill-llama-8b) is set in Settings and sent to the person's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter in the template's notes); the bench's OpenAI credential points at the shim. Simple Memory holds one turn per run, keyed by the session id.
